import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long inf = 100000000000000000L;
    static final int max_n = 1001;
    static int[] xdir = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] ydir = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static List<Integer>[] gr = new ArrayList[max_n];
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[max_n];
    static int[] pa = new int[max_n];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < max_n; i++) {
            gr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y, String[] s) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < s.length && y < s.length && s[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && s[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }

    static long[][] bfs(int st_x, int st_y, String[] s) {
        int n = s.length;
        long[][] res = new long[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(res[i], inf);
        }
        res[st_x][st_y] = 0;
        Deque<int[]> b = new ArrayDeque<>();
        b.offer(new int[]{st_x, st_y});
        while (!b.isEmpty()) {
            int[] v = b.pollFirst();
            int vx = v[0], vy = v[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x = vx + xdir[i];
                int y = vy + ydir[i];
                if (!check(x, y, s) || res[x][y] != inf) continue;
                res[x][y] = res[vx][vy] + 1;
                b.offer(new int[]{x, y});
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void scan(Scanner sc) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        String[] s1 = new String[n];
        String[] s2 = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s1[i] = sc.next();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s2[i] = sc.next();
        }

        int x_reac = -1, y_reac = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (s1[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    x_reac = i;
                    y_reac = j;
                }
            }
        }

        long[][] reac = bfs(x_reac, y_reac, s1);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (!check(i, j, s1)) continue;
                long[][] a = bfs(i, j, s1);
                for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                        if (!check(x, y, s1) || a[x][y] > t || a[x][y] > reac[x][y]) continue;
                        if (a[x][y] == reac[x][y]) {
                            boolean good = false;
                            for (int id = 0; id < 4; id++) {
                                int xto = x + xdir[id];
                                int yto = y + ydir[id];
                                if (!check(xto, yto, s1) || a[xto][yto] >= reac[xto][yto]) continue;
                                good = true;
                            }
                            if (!good) continue;
                        }
                        int val1 = s1[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                        int val2 = s2[x].charAt(y) - '0';
                        for (int num1 = 1; num1 <= val1; num1++) {
                            for (int num2 = 1; num2 <= val2; num2++) {
                                int from = 10 * (j + i * 10) + num1;
                                int to = 10 * (y + 10 * x) + num2;
                                gr[from].add(to);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean kuhn(int v) {
        if (used[v]) return false;
        used[v] = true;
        for (int to : gr[v]) {
            if (pa[to] == 0 || kuhn(pa[to])) {
                pa[to] = v;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void solve(Scanner sc) {
        // Clear previous graph data
        for (int i = 0; i < max_n; i++) {
            gr[i].clear();
        }
        Arrays.fill(pa, 0);
        Arrays.fill(used, false);
        scan(sc);
        int n = max_n;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(used, false);
            kuhn(i);
            Arrays.fill(used, false);
        }
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (pa[i] != 0) res++;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        solve(sc);
        sc.close();
    }
}
